doc_name: Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly of Pakistan
text: The deputy speaker of the National Assembly of Pakistan presides over the assembly when the speaker is absent or unable to perform their duties. This office originated in 1947, when the deputy speaker was known as the Deputy President of the legislative assembly. Following the ratification of the 1973 Constitution of Pakistan, the office was re-established. Currently, Ghulam Mustafa Shah holds the position of Deputy Speaker and was elected by the National Assembly of Pakistan on 1 March 2024, alongside Speaker Ayaz Sadiq. The office is established by Article 53 of Chapter 2 in Part III of the Constitution of Pakistan. The Deputy Speaker assumes the role of Speaker when the Speaker is unable to serve; however, if both the Speaker and Deputy Speaker are unable to fulfill their duties, another individual is appointed to temporarily act as Speaker. The period referenced in the document is 12 August 1955 – 07 October 1958.
